purpose: W4-A: extend the existing durable Shipment authority with logistics request/quote, provider-or-own-fleet selection, multi-shipment allocation, correction events and durable offline driver queue consumption without creating ShipmentV2.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP post-registration specification with existing push/PR/merge authorization. Implementation remains blocked until this finite scope is independently accepted and promoted into immutable base-state authority.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: Deal authority remains a source reference; W4-A must not broaden Deal command semantics.
Existing LogisticsModule is already mounted; no global module mutation is required.
Driver/logistics UX and offline-queue consumption are separate acceptance after server authority is complete; this foundation must not hide missing authority with client behavior.
Global CI remains an independent gate.
Generic additive migration checker remains unchanged.

requiredInvariants: Reuse the current Shipment, checkpoint, GPS, PIN, admission and immutable assignment authorities; do not create ShipmentV2 or a second logistics engine.
One Deal may have multiple explicitly allocated shipments whose exact quantity sum cannot exceed the authoritative Deal/inventory allocation quantity.

Logistics request, provider quote, provider selection and transport mode selection are separate immutable facts. OWN_FLEET is a first-class mode gated by current organization capability OWN_TRANSPORT, not a fake provider record.
Selecting a provider or own fleet does not itself create a payment obligation; commercial payer/price remains governed by Commercial Rules and later Settlement authority.
Shipment correction never rewrites accepted history. Route, vehicle, driver, quantity or schedule correction creates a new immutable correction/event version with reason and actor authority.
Current user, membership, organization, tenant and required capability are revalidated before mutation and replay. Revocation cannot replay an old logistics receipt as current authority.
Split/merge shipment operations conserve exact pinned-unit quantity and cannot detach a shipment from its canonical Deal/inventory basis.

Driver fact ingestion remains append-only and idempotent. Offline delivery may be delayed/retried but cannot reorder a state transition into an invalid lifecycle or manufacture GPS/admission evidence.
Same-tenant outsiders and cross-tenant callers cannot read private shipment assignments, quotes, driver facts or corrections.
Every mutation commits state, immutable event, audit and outbox atomically; missing evidence rolls the whole command back.
ATI and other external carriers remain provider adapters only. No external success is claimed by W4-A and no ATI-specific field becomes core Shipment authority.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, W2 Inventory/Auction/Deal work, packages/lockfiles and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove request -> quote -> provider or OWN_FLEET selection -> one or multiple shipments without exceeding exact quantity.
OWN_FLEET is denied without current OWN_TRANSPORT capability and accepted with it, with no synthetic external provider success.
Concurrent split/assignment/correction commands serialize deterministically and preserve quantity conservation.
Revoked membership/capability/user/organization authority fails before mutation and before idempotent replay response.
Cross-tenant and same-tenant outsider reads/writes are denied; assigned driver/provider/requester access remains explicitly scoped.
Changed-payload replay, stale version and correction of already superseded facts fail closed.
Audit/outbox/event failure leaves no partial logistics state or acknowledged command.
Existing checkpoint/GPS/PIN/admission tests remain green; global CI, forward migrations, no public schema drift, restore, cryptographic freshness and exact-head review pass unchanged.
remainingTerminalBoundary: User-facing logistics marketplace/provider comparison and real own-fleet workflows remain later UX acceptance.
Durable offline queue must be wired into the live driver screen and tested under reconnect/out-of-order conditions before terminal LOGISTICS credit.
ATI board/auction/order/webhook/tracking/docs remain separate adapter criteria and are not claimed by W4-A.
Verified REG.RU runtime and real logistics/driver acceptance remain required before LOGISTICS/OWN_TRANSPORT terminal credit.
